Here's how the versus game works!{KP}Press the Circle button to shoot an arrow at the center of the target!{KP}You'll face off split into an upper row and a lower row!{KP}It's 3 rounds, and whoever scores more wins!{KP}The closer to the center you hit, the faster the light moves on your opponent's target!{KP}Give your opponent a really hard time!{KP}1P is Momotaro-san on the upper row, and 2P is Kintaro-san on the lower row!
